title: A SEAL CUT PAST THE NEW NEED STILL OPENS
why: Found by the code comb of 2026-10-07: v17.97 made the seal quicker to cut (34 + 21 per stage), and a profile that had already banked more cutting than the new need (36 of the old 40, say) could never finish it: the cut was skipped, so the completion test never ran, the bar sat full and nothing happened, and that sector seal was stuck for good. The cut always runs now; the first moment of E on such a door completes it and pays out.
now: A seal that was stuck full after the quicker-seal change now opens the moment you hold E at it.
